title: Knowledge Entry profile — salesforce.report-type v1
description: typeFacts carry the collector's extraction faithfully: an adapter passes every fact through except a documented exclusion, so a fact the profile does not declare fails validation loudly instead of vanishing from the entry. Documented limitation: join-path tables (Base.Child__r) name relationships, not objects, so their columns are skipped deliberately when deriving references-field edges — columnCount can exceed the edge count without any truncation having occurred.

tables.description: Every table the type exposes, including join-path tables (Base.Child__r) whose columns emit no field edges.

columnCount.description: True total of declared columns across all tables — deliberately larger than the edge count when join-path tables are present.
